findings.summary: An item whose quantity equals the threshold is left out.
findings.detail: The Story says "at or below the threshold". The comparison is `quantity < threshold`, so low_stock(5) does not list an item with quantity 5.
The Story requires ValueError for a negative threshold. low_stock(-1) returns an empty list.

findings.summary: The tests cover neither the boundary, nor the empty result, nor the negative threshold.
findings.detail: Each acceptance criterion needs a unit test.
